scope: Supplemental urban sources; incomplete attributes do not satisfy the pooled master schema.

winners.unit: one published ward councilor per election, corporation and ward

fields.name: year
fields.description: Election year, not collection year.

fields.name: body
fields.description: Municipal corporation named by the source.

fields.name: ward_no
fields.description: Printed ward identifier; not a cross-election geographic key.

fields.name: winner
fields.description: Printed winner name, with whitespace normalized.

fields.name: winner_raw
fields.description: Unnormalized name cell or checked historical transcription.

fields.name: winner_basis
fields.description: Winner selection evidence.

fields.name: winner_party
fields.description: Printed party with whitespace normalized; absent in 2014.

fields.name: winner_party_raw
fields.description: Unnormalized party cell; absent in 2014.

fields.name: reserved_raw
fields.description: Original seat reservation cell; absent in 2014.

fields.name: reserved_caste
fields.description: Seat caste reservation; NONE means no caste reservation, not missing.

fields.name: reserved_woman
fields.description: 1 if women-reserved, 0 if not; null when the source does not state it.

fields.name: reserved_basis
fields.description: Evidence for the reservation fields.

fields.name: winner_woman_raw
fields.description: Recorded person sex cell; unavailable in both winner sources.

fields.name: winner_woman
fields.description: Recorded winner sex: 1 woman, 0 man, null unknown; never inferred from reservation.

fields.name: winner_woman_basis
fields.description: Evidence for winner sex; neither source records it.

fields.name: source_path
fields.description: Original source path relative to the repository root.

fields.name: source_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the complete original source payload.

fields.name: source_page
fields.description: One-based physical PDF page.

fields.name: source_column
fields.description: One-based left/right table column in 2014; not applicable in 2022.

fields.name: source_row
fields.description: One-based row within a 2014 column or 2022 extracted table, including table headers.

fields.name: extraction_method
fields.description: How the source row was read.

fields.name: raw_record_json
fields.description: Original PDF cells or historical transcription row as JSON.

affidavit_documents.unit: one affidavit document link; repeated filings remain distinct

fields.name: year
fields.description: Election year, not collection year.

fields.name: body
fields.description: Municipal corporation named by the source.

fields.name: document_serial
fields.description: Printed directory ordinal; a document key, not a person identifier.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Directory link text with whitespace normalized.

fields.name: title_raw
fields.description: Unmodified text content of the directory link.

fields.name: office
fields.description: Office named in the filing label.

fields.name: ward_no
fields.description: Ward identifier from the directory label; null for mayor filings.

fields.name: candidate_label
fields.description: Candidate portion of the normalized directory label; copy/version suffixes retained.

fields.name: document_url
fields.description: Original document href, including spaces.

fields.name: download_status
fields.description: Status in the retained receipt ledger.

fields.name: downloaded_path
fields.description: Canonical stored PDF path; byte-identical source links can share it.

fields.name: downloaded_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the downloaded PDF.

fields.name: downloaded_bytes
fields.description: Downloaded payload size in bytes.

fields.name: downloaded_at
fields.description: UTC request time from the original download receipt.

fields.name: pdf_pages
fields.description: Readable PDF page count at acquisition.

fields.name: source_path
fields.description: Original source path relative to the repository root.

fields.name: source_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the complete original source payload.
